name: eleviq-booking
title: ElevIQ Booking
description: MCP server for booking a free 30-minute intro call with Matthias Jung of ElevIQ Solutions (AI agent readiness audits and agentic web monetization strategy). The same backend is also reachable as a plain REST API for agents that don't speak MCP — see documentation_url.

tools.name: list_slots
tools.title: List bookable call slots
tools.description: List the bookable slots for the free 30-minute intro call.

tools.name: book_slot
tools.title: Book a call slot
tools.description: Book a free 30-minute intro call. Requires a slot id from list_slots plus the name and email of the person the call is for.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.title: Join the waitlist
tools.description: Join the waitlist when no free call slots are available.

mcp.note: Full input/output schemas are served live by the MCP server itself via tools/list — this card is a discovery pointer, not a schema mirror.
